dedupe_keys.name: noto peninsula 2024 tsunami post event survey

description: The Noto Peninsula survey team publishes a workbook of post-event tsunami measurements after the 1 January 2024 earthquake in Japan. Its own Figshare child item is CC0 and contains an XLSX file; the broader Figshare collection also includes photographs. The article reports 303 surveyed inundation or run-up records along roughly 340 kilometres of coast, with coordinates, measurement methods, tidal corrections and descriptive notes. These points can check tsunami inundation or evacuation-exposure simulations against observed heights. A caveat is that post-event traces vary in quality and do not reconstruct the full water-level time history. Survey height types and datum corrections must be retained when comparing locations. The resource is the actual survey workbook, not the collection of photo items. I read the own Figshare file metadata and article Data Records without downloading the workbook, inspecting photos or reproducing hydrodynamics. No directly related catalogue record was identified. Coverage is the Noto Peninsula and adjacent Japanese Sea coast.
